A field guide to an inhabited world · volume X · the rabbit family

Jackalopes

Five rabbit monster girls: the moon rabbit Inaba, the antlered Jack, the Easter Bunny, the horned Al-mi'raj of the desert and the tiny volcano rabbit. Quick, skittish and lucky: a jackalope who likes you enough to follow you around brings her luck with her.

Favourite food: Carrots (a golden carrot above all)

The central similarity

Luck runs on four fast feet.

Rabbits are prey animals, so every jackalope's first instinct is to bolt. Win one over with carrots and she follows you instead, and while she does, fortune favours you.

  • CarrotsThe family's favourite food. A golden carrot is worth three ordinary ones.
  • SkittishThey flee from anyone sprinting at them, and from wolves, foxes and cats.
  • Lucky companionsAt high friendship she follows you around, and you have Luck while she is near.
  • Burrows and leapsBig jumps, no fall damage below six blocks, and they dig into dirt when frightened.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a jackalope builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Carrots (+1), golden carrots (+3)
  • Petting while you crouch
  • Sneaking up gently instead of chasing her

What costs trust

  • Sprinting at her
  • Hitting her
  • Letting a wolf or fox near her

Devoted (60+)

She never wanders off: she sticks to you, your Luck becomes Luck II, and she brings you a rabbit's foot now and then.

Mating & young

FormLive litter in a scrape. YoungKits (3-4), grown in 5 days. WhereSoft ground near her sleeping spot. Kits use the adult model at 45% scale.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may share your bed at night; by morning she is expecting.
2. The warrenShe digs a shallow scrape in soft ground near where she sleeps and lines it with grass and fur.
3. The litterThree or four kits are born at once (rabbits are famous for it), each a random colour of her species.
4. GrownKits grow up in five days, devoted to the player who fathered them.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

BoltingAnything that rushes her sends her zig-zagging away at full speed; a sneaking player can come close.
Lucky followerAt high friendship (25+) she follows her favourite player and gives Luck while within eight blocks.
Big jumpsShe clears two blocks in a hop and takes no fall damage from short drops.
BurrowingFrightened in the open, she digs into dirt or sand and hides for a while.
Garden raidsWild jackalopes nibble ripe carrots out of farms. Befriended ones leave your crops alone.

Species profiles

Full-moon meadowsCelestial · swift

Inaba (about 1.55 blocks)

TemperamentDreamy, playful, impossible to catch

Ecology & behaviourThe moon rabbit who pounds rice cakes on the moon. She only comes down on full-moon nights and is the fastest thing on two legs.

Signature: Moon-blessedSpawns only at night under a full moon. Once a player has caught her (any right-click), all her affection gains are doubled. She glows faintly in moonlight.

Player interactionCatch her (get a hand on her at all) and she is yours far faster than any other jackalope.

Jack (about 1.7 blocks)

TemperamentBold, cocky, a show-off

Ecology & behaviourThe jackalope of tall tales: a rabbit with a deer's antlers. She spars with anything that challenges her.

Signature: Antler chargeShe charges whatever hurts her (or her player), knocking it back hard. Her antlers fall off every few days and can be collected (a bone-like trophy).

Player interactionCarrots, and never back down when she struts at you.

Spawns inbadlands, wooded_badlands, savanna, plains

DangerModerate if you start it.

Flower forests & meadowsCheerful · sneaky

Easter Bunny (about 1.5 blocks)

TemperamentCheerful, secretive, giggly

Ecology & behaviourShe paints eggs and hides them everywhere: in grass, under bushes, behind trees.

Signature: Hidden eggsEvery few minutes she hides a painted egg block nearby. Breaking one gives a small treat (cookies, dyes, gold nuggets, now and then an emerald).

Player interactionFind her eggs. Every egg you find and bring back makes her laugh with delight (+2).

Al-mi'raj (about 1.5 blocks)

TemperamentFierce, proud, devoted to her clan

Ecology & behaviourThe golden horned hare of the desert legends, with a single spiral horn. Lives in clans that defend each other.

Signature: Clan defenceHurt one and every Al-mi'raj within 24 blocks attacks you. Her horn hits hard. A devoted Al-mi'raj defends you the same way.

Player interactionBring the whole clan carrots; never hurt one of them in front of the others.

Volcano Rabbit (about 1.2 blocks)

TemperamentVery shy, sweet, easily winded

Ecology & behaviourA tiny round-eared rabbit of the volcano slopes. She lives near lava and is never burnt by it.

Signature: Shy and tires easilyShe bolts from anyone not crouching, but runs out of breath after a few seconds and has to stop and pant. Immune to fire and lava.

Player interactionSit still near her (crouch) and offer a carrot.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Carrots (golden carrot +3); petting needs a crouch
  • Bolting from sprinters (the volcano rabbit from anyone not crouching), wolves, foxes, cats
  • Follows her favourite at high friendship and gives Luck (Luck II when devoted)
  • Big jumps, no damage from short falls
  • Inaba: full-moon night spawns, glows, doubled affection once caught
  • Jack: antler knockback, sheds antlers (bones) every few days
  • Easter Bunny: hides painted egg blocks (a treat when broken, +2 and a treat when brought back)
  • Al-mi'raj: clan defends any member (and her devoted player)
  • Volcano rabbit: fireproof, spawns only near lava, runs out of breath and pants
  • Litters of 3-4 kits

Not yet

  • Burrowing into dirt when frightened
  • Raiding carrot farms

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • Carrots are the family food; the golden carrot is worth three.
  • Luck needs her following you (high friendship) and close (8 blocks).

Open questions

  • Should the Inaba bring rice cakes (a new food) at full devotion?
